newsitem.title: USA: Hugh Grant hooker Divine Brown ordered arrested.
newsitem.headline: Hugh Grant hooker Divine Brown ordered arrested.

text.p: Divine Brown, the Hollywood hooker who was caught in a car with actor Hugh Grant last year, was ordered arrested on Monday after she failed to appear in court for unrelated prostitution charges.

A spokeswoman for the Clark County District Attorney's office in Las Vegas said neither Brown nor her attorney turned up for the scheduled appearance and as a result a bench warrant was issued for her arrest.
Her whereabouts were unknown and Brown's lawyer in Los Angeles was not immediately available for comment.

Brown, whose real name is Estella Maria Thompson, was among 43 people arrested in a Sept. 10 Las Vegas police sting operation at the MGM Grand Hotel and Casino. She was charged with loitering for the purpose of prostitution, aiding and abetting prostitution and resisting arrest.
If found guilty she would face a sentence of up to six months in jail and a fine of up to $500 for each of the three misdemeanor counts against her.
She had been released on bail the day after her arrest and was scheduled to appear for arraignment on Monday.
Brown became famous last year when she and Grant were arrested after vice squad officers spotted them engaging in a sexual act in a car near Sunset Boulevard in Los Angeles.
Grant, who has starred in films as "Four Weddings and a Funeral" and the current "Extreme Measures" publicly apologised for the scandal and was fined $1,800.
Brown was fined $1,350 and given a jail term of 180 days.
